approval_required_for: Any proposed change to accelerator architecture, pipeline structure, memory layout, numeric policy, or major template selection requires the applicable human approval before adoption.
Any unresolved human-boundary approval specified by the detailed boundary artifact must be recorded and obtained before adopting the affected delta.

executable_actions.on_failure: Record each failed or not_run checker against its relevant constraint and source artifact. Keep the audit incomplete, do not promote the graph, and route any required repair through the responsible specialist without changing golden outputs or relaxing constraints.
executable_actions.rationale: The supplied summaries report no validation errors but do not establish reference integrity, template binding, or boundary compliance. Run the registered checks on the current graph and source inputs to produce checker-grounded evidence.

executable_actions.on_failure: If specialist artifacts, required checker evidence, or detailed completion/non-fallback status cannot be verified, record the affected review as unresolved or not_run and withhold downstream handoff. Do not convert missing detail into a pass or silently rewrite specialist findings.

Obtain and reconcile the parallel specialist review artifacts and proposed deltas against source inputs and checker evidence. Record each delta as accepted, rejected, or unresolved with its provenance; mark unavailable evidence as not_run rather than as a pass.
